description_en: Freezes or unfreezes a specified node
description_zh: 调用UpdateNodeRunMode接口冻结或解冻目标节点
name: UpdateNodeRunMode

parameters.help_en: The environment in which the node runs. Valid values: DEV (development environment) and PROD (production environment)
parameters.help_zh: 运行的环境，包括开发环境（DEV）和生产环境（PRD）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The node ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html operation to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 节点的ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html接口获取节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The operation to perform on the specified node. Valid values:

0: unfreezes the specified node.
2: freezes the specified node
parameters.help_zh:
需要对目标节点执行的操作。取值如下：
0：表示解冻目标节点。
2：表示冻结目标节点
parameters.name: scheduler_type

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
返回值。取值如下：
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
